summary: Buffered decompression-stream read: reads up to a3 bytes from a buffered stream object (a1), clamped to available bytes at stream+4, advancing the internal read pointer and total-read counter, with conditional consumption bookkeeping through sub_537D10 when a flag at *(*(a1+28)+24) is clear.

operations.description: clamp requested count: v4 = min(available bytes at stream+4, requested a3)
if v4 is zero, return 0 immediately (nothing readable)
reduce remaining-bytes counter at stream+4 by v4
if the flag at *(*(stream+28)+24) is zero, run consumption bookkeeping and store its result at stream+48
call sub_537D10(v4); result written into stream+48
copy v4 bytes from the current buffer pointer at stream+0 into destination a2
advance the current buffer pointer at stream+0 by v4
accumulate v4 into the total-read counter at stream+8
return v4 (number of bytes actually read)
